meta.description: Corning Inc (GLW) analysis: Fiber optics leader riding AI data center boom, Meta $6B deal, 20% revenue growth. Price correction from $162 to $123 creates entry opportunity.
meta.ogDescription: GLW: Specialty glass & fiber optics leader. Meta $6B supply deal, AI data center tailwind, 20% YoY revenue growth. Pullback entry at $121.

badges.text: NYSE Technology AI Infrastructure Fiber Optics Materials

verdict.summary: Corning is a 175-year-old specialty glass and ceramics company that manufactures optical fiber for telecom and data centers, display glass for TVs and phones, Gorilla Glass for mobile devices, automotive substrates for emissions control, and life sciences labware. The company is uniquely positioned at the intersection of multiple secular growth themes: AI data center infrastructure, 5G rollout, foldable displays, and electric vehicles.
whyBuy: AI Data Center Megatrend: Multi-year $6B fiber optic supply deal with Meta Platforms. AI capex cycle just beginning — Corning is a primary beneficiary.
Accelerating Growth: Revenue growth of 20.4% YoY with earnings growth of 77.4%. Four consecutive earnings beats (Q1-Q4 2025). Margin expansion underway.
Technical Pullback Entry: -24.7% correction from highs, RSI at 44.6, EMA 50 acting as support at $119.25. Classic shakeout pattern after parabolic move.
whyAvoid: Elevated Valuation: P/B of 8.95x and EV/Revenue of 7.3x are historically high for Corning. The stock has priced in significant growth.
Debt Load: $9.4B in total debt vs $1.5B cash. Net debt of ~$7.9B is manageable with EBITDA of $3.7B but limits flexibility.
Momentum Reversal Risk: MACD below signal line, price below EMA 20 ($135.6). Could see further downside to EMA 200 ($87.5) in a broad market selloff.

risks.riskSummary: Corning faces moderate risks primarily from elevated valuation, debt load, and dependence on the AI capex cycle continuing. Company-specific risks are low (no dilution, strong balance sheet, proven management).

riskCards.title: Valuation Risk
points: EV/EBITDA of 31.1x is historically high for Corning (5Y avg ~15x)
P/B of 8.95x prices in significant growth expectations
Any slowdown in AI capex could trigger a multiple compression

risks.pedagogy: The pullback from $162 to $122 is a textbook post-parabolic correction, not a fundamental deterioration. Three factors drove the selloff: (1) Profit-taking after a +90% run in 4 months, (2) Broad market weakness in tech/growth names amid tariff uncertainty, (3) Options-related selling as March expiration approaches. The fundamental thesis (AI fiber optic demand, Meta $6B deal, earnings acceleration) remains fully intact. This is a shakeout of weak hands, not a trend reversal.

tradeIdea.thesis: This is a mean-reversion trade on a fundamentally strong stock experiencing a technical pullback. The stock has corrected -25% from its parabolic high while fundamentals (20% revenue growth, Meta $6B deal, 4 consecutive earnings beats) remain unchanged. The EMA 50 at $119.25 has acted as reliable support throughout the uptrend. Entry at the current $118-122 zone offers an asymmetric risk/reward with multiple upside catalysts.
